fact: WHO's Comoros annual report for 2024 states that before 2023 DHIS2 was not in place at national scale, and that WHO, with financing from the SDG Fund and Gavi, equipped the Direction de l'Information et des Statistiques Sanitaires, the regional directorates and the health districts with computers and trained 170 health workers on DHIS2, with data completeness rising from under 50% to 90%.
title: Rapport annuel : performances et perspectives 2024
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau de l'OMS Comores
